features.text: DUAL-PURPOSE RELIEF: Designed for both knee and elbow tendon pain, including jumper’s knee and tennis elbow.
TARGETED PRESSURE PAD: Provides focused compression to alleviate tendon irritation and strain.
LOW-PROFILE COMFORT: Discreet design allows full range of motion during activity.
DURABLE ELASTIC STRAP: Offers consistent support without restricting mobility.
PDAC APPROVED A4467: Meets insurance standards for tendon support devices.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
